ad_info.reference_style: Authentic customer-style smartphone mirror selfie holding the product, with native story-style text stickers; deliberately unpolished and real, like an organic story posted by a customer
ad_info.angle_used: Identidad / aspiración: her goal is for her jeans to finally fit her right, naturally

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, and aguaje orange #D9572B only for fruit accents.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement ad: clean pink and blush backgrounds, ultra-photorealistic Colombian women photographed naturally and respectfully, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, clean icon modules.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident, warm and aspirational; soft daylight, believable real-life moments.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded pills and banners in fuchsia and deep magenta, thin-line white icons inside fuchsia circles, handwritten script accents used sparingly, clean flat or softly graded backgrounds with minimal decoration (no clutter, no excess particles, petals or sparkles).
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold (uppercase, heavy) for headlines and labels, Poppins Regular for supporting text, and a casual handwritten script for short emotional accents.

creative_objective: Feel like a real story posted by a Colombian woman: in her bedroom mirror, in jeans, holding the bottle and sharing her goal of having her jeans fit right, with a natural plan and no surgery. Identification first, product second, no ad look.

art_direction.design_quality: Authentic and native-looking, yet clean and legible on mobile
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The top story caption. 2) Her face and happy, determined expression. 3) The bottle held up toward the mirror. 4) The smaller secondary sticker and its hand-drawn arrow pointing to the bottle.
art_direction.composition_style: Handheld mirror selfie cropped to square, slight 2-degree tilt, framed from about mid-thigh up. A generic phone with no logos covers part of her chin area but never her eyes. Face in the upper-middle slightly left; the bottle held up on the right at chest height, label toward the mirror. Stickers over low-detail areas.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Top caption x 10-90%, y 5-19%. Face around x 26-56%, y 22-52%. Bottle around x 54-86%, y 38-80%, about 28% of the canvas height. Secondary sticker x 8-45%, y 76-88%, with a white hand-drawn arrow curving to the bottle. 5% safe margins.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Real window daylight mixed with a warm bedside lamp, slight phone sharpening and mild grain, natural skin texture with pores, limited phone depth of field, no studio light and no cinematic grading.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square casual mirror selfie in a real Colombian bedroom. A woman about 27 years old in blue jeans and a pink blouse looks at her phone screen in the mirror with a happy, determined smile and holds the bottle up toward the mirror at chest height, label readable. At the top, a story-style caption on rounded white boxes with black text. In the lower-left corner, a smaller fuchsia sticker with white text and a white hand-drawn arrow curving to the bottle. No other graphics.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Real bedroom that makes it feel like a real customer's photo
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Lived-in but tidy Colombian bedroom seen in a full-length mirror: a made bed with a light pink blanket, a small wardrobe and a window with daylight, slightly out of focus.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Center to center-left, about 60-70% of the frame, face around x 26-56%, y 22-52%
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: The customer whose goal the viewer shares
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Ultra-photorealistic Colombian woman about 27 years old, medium-brown skin with real texture and pores, dark wavy hair loose, minimal makeup, wearing classic blue jeans and a fitted bubblegum pink blouse, framed from mid-thigh up, standing naturally facing the mirror (not turned sideways, no posing of hips or buttocks), happy determined smile.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Held up on the right at chest height, around x 54-86%, y 38-80%
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows exactly what she is using for her goal
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: The user's bottle exactly as in the attached photo, held in one hand toward the mirror, label readable, about 28% of the canvas height, sharp, never covering her face.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: The hook, written as her own caption
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Each line on its own rounded white box hugging the text, near-black text, max 2 lines, centered over the headroom.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Names the bottle as her natural plan
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Smaller story label in a hot fuchsia #E6177F box with white text, max 2 lines.

detected_visual_blocks.position: From the secondary sticker curving toward the bottle
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Directs the eye to the product in a native, handmade way
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Single white freehand marker-style arrow, slightly wobbly, ending near but not over the label.

forbidden_additions: Studio lighting, seamless backdrop or heavy retouching
Graphic ad headline in display typography outside the stickers
Real platform interface elements (progress bars, usernames, like or share buttons, platform logos)
Emoji, GIF, poll, question or location stickers
Logos or brand marks other than those printed on the product label
Side or back poses that highlight hips or buttocks

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 authentic smartphone mirror selfie, deliberately unpolished, like a real Instagram story by a customer. Setting: a lived-in but tidy Colombian bedroom seen in a full-length mirror, a made bed with a light pink blanket, a small wardrobe and a window with soft daylight mixed with a warm bedside lamp, slightly out of focus with typical phone depth of field, mild digital grain, slight 2-degree tilt. Subject: an ultra-photorealistic Colombian woman about 27 years old, medium-brown skin with real texture and visible pores, dark wavy hair worn loose, minimal makeup, wearing classic blue jeans and a fitted bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 blouse, framed from mid-thigh up, standing naturally facing the mirror (not turned sideways, no posing of the hips), with a happy, determined smile. With one hand she holds a generic phone with no logos at face height (covering only part of her chin, never her eyes); with the other hand she holds the product bottle up at chest height on the right side of the frame (around 54-86% of the width and 38-80% of the height, about 28% of the canvas height), label facing the mirror, in sharp focus, never covering her face. The bottle must be reproduced exactly from the attached product image (the only source of truth; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it): a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type. Because it is a mirror, keep the label text reading correctly (not mirrored). Overlays: at the top center (x 10-90%, y 5-19%), a native story caption, each of its two lines on its own rounded white box hugging the text, near-black rounded sans-serif text, centered. In the lower-left corner (x 8-45%, y 76-88%), a smaller hot fuchsia #E6177F sticker box with white text, and a single white wobbly freehand marker arrow curving from it toward the bottle, ending near but not over the label. No other graphics, no platform interface, no CTA, no price, no stars, no extra people.

text_layers.text_style: Bold rounded sans-serif in classic story-caption style, about 4.5% of the canvas height, centered, near-black text on rounded white boxes hugging each line, 2 lines
text_layers.text: Mi meta: que el jean por fin me horme

text_layers.reference_position: Lower-left corner, connected to the arrow
text_layers.text_style: Same story-caption font, about 3.2% of the canvas height, left-aligned, max 2 lines, white text on a hot fuchsia box

mandatory_visual_elements: Real-looking Colombian woman in jeans holding the bottle toward the mirror
Bedroom mirror-selfie setting with imperfect natural light and phone-camera grain
Story-style caption at the top on rounded white boxes
Smaller fuchsia secondary sticker with a white hand-drawn arrow pointing to the bottle
final_generation_exclusions: No mirrored or reversed text on the bottle label or stickers.
No side or back pose and no emphasis on hips or buttocks.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish.
